beats.summary: Andy tries to rig and sail his boat but is repeatedly stopped by the Boat Guy who enforces rules and insurance restrictions.

evidence.snippet: Boat Guy: Trying to rig a boat here. I don't know how to do that when you're standing in the way.
Boat Guy: We've already started boarding. And no one is insured to rig her up right now except us.

beats.summary: Erin supports Andy's role as captain and encourages him despite the boat ownership complications.

evidence.snippet: Erin: As long as we're on this boat, as far as I'm concerned, you're the captain.

beats.summary: Boat Guy informs Andy that he has already signed the papers and the boat is effectively sold, with the deposit forfeited.

evidence.snippet: Boat Guy: OK, no. I already said, you're not getting back your deposit.

beats.summary: Andy finds his brother Walter Jr passed out on the boat and invites him to join a sober sailing trip.

evidence.snippet: Walter Jr: Oh god, thank goodness you're here. I was having a little trouble with this door.

beats.summary: Dwight attempts to negotiate with David Wallace, who is holding a mailman hostage, urging him to surrender peacefully.
